label: Деньги
description: A 10-sentence usage card for деньги (money), a plural-only noun.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Деньги' is a plurale tantum and serves as the nominative subject of 'лежат'. 'На столе' is prepositional marking location.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Деньги' is the accusative direct object of 'заработал', identical to the nominative for this inanimate plural. 'Хорошие' agrees in the plural.
Strategic focus: Genitive of negation. 'Денег' is the genitive plural required after 'нет'. The possession frame 'у меня' shows whose lack it is.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'Деньгам' is the dative plural after 'благодаря' to mean thanks to the money. A useful cause construction.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of means. 'Деньгами' is the instrumental plural showing what was used to pay. 'Наличными' agrees in the instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Деньгах' is the prepositional plural after 'о' to give the topic. 'Постоянно' adds the frequency.
Strategic focus: Genitive of quantity. 'Денег' is the genitive plural after 'немного'. 'Мне' is the dative recipient of 'дай'.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Деньги' is the nominative plural subject. 'Эти' agrees in the plural, and 'для тебя' uses the genitive pronoun.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Деньги' is the accusative object of 'потратил', matching the nominative form. 'Все' agrees in the plural, and 'вчера' gives the time.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after preposition. 'Деньгами' is instrumental after 'с' to mean with money. 'Проще' is the comparative predicate.
